$schema_note: L0B authoring overlay (lane/l0-authoring). SOURCE OF TRUTH for interaction/answer-model/blocker/image metadata of the 15 Level 0B Placement Worksheet tasks. Consumed by scripts/conversion/apply-l0-overlay.ts. Mirrors the proven l2-authoring.json shape with the L0 additions from l0-authoring-spec.md. The 0B booklet RAMPS: per the Summary table LEVEL column, tasks 1-12 band 0A and tasks 13-15 band 0B (HARD RULE 1: band by level column, not doc name). Content for the 7 existing rows (Q02,Q05,Q07,Q08,Q09,Q14,Q15) was model-reconstructed and WRONG; re-authored from the docx/crops (HARD RULE 2). Stems are verbatim 'Tap'-adapted text; trailing Fill-in-the-blanks/Answer lines folded into the answer model (HARD RULE 3). Held image-tap/multi-blank rows store a MULTIPLE_CHOICE placeholder format with the real interaction in authoring.target_interaction (+ answer_model, audit-only, not emitted to SQL). Active rows' content is clean (no _authoring; the applier omits it and auto-injects the _authoring stub for held rows). image_path is never set here (founder uploads later); image_alt is deliberately NON-revealing.

meta.band_note: HARD RULE 1: banded by the Summary table LEVEL column. Tasks 1-12 = 0A, tasks 13-15 = 0B. The existing 7 KB rows were mis-banded (KA/KB); re-banded here via the update.level field.
meta.content_note: HARD RULE 2: the existing SAM-L0B-Q<N> ids map correctly to printed task numbers, but their content was model-reconstructed and is wrong. All content re-authored from the docx stems + crops.

blocker_legend.none: active, auto-gradeable from STEM TEXT ALONE, supported format (NUMERIC_ENTRY/TEXT_ENTRY/MULTIPLE_CHOICE with text options)
blocker_legend.A: answer depends on an image but the format would be wired; founder rule keeps it inactive (is_active=false, held=true, requires_format_swap=false). Uses the real wired format + non-revealing image_alt.
blocker_legend.C: real interaction is not a wired format (click-image tap one/many, multi-blank, select-multiple, image-ordering, path). Placeholder format MULTIPLE_CHOICE, requires_format_swap=true, is_active=false, held=true. Real interaction in authoring.target_interaction; answer in authoring.answer_model.

meta.task6_answer_conflict: Task 6 stem 'Tap the numbers greater than 6' but the answer key text says 'Color 7 and 6'. Crop 0B-06.png does NOT show a number grid/tiles with printed numbers — it is a horizontal NUMBER LINE (two filled endpoint dots + 4 interior tick marks, NO printed numbers visible on the crop). So the actual on-page numbers and the correct subset cannot be determined from this crop. The conflict is genuine and unresolved: 'greater than 6' would exclude 6, but the key includes 6 (likely the key answers a different/adjacent task or a 'color 6 and 7' counting task). FLAGGED here and recorded in SAM-L0B-Q06.authoring.answer_model.conflict for the founder to resolve before activation. Held-C regardless (select-multiple over an image is not a wired format).
